purpose: Target-expansion registry separating active, data-backed planetary reference profiles from candidate regions awaiting compatible DEM ingestion and QA.
policy: A target marked planned is not active in the scoring pipeline.
Do not assign coordinates, terrain metrics or scores until the authoritative planetary product and coordinate reference are ingested and validated.
Artemis landing-region labels describe NASA-published candidate regions at the cited release date; they are not current operational landing-site selections or endorsements.
One target's terrain profile must not be substituted for another target within the same planetary body.
